themes.title: Energy Policy as Political Battleground
themes.blurb: Right‑wing outlets in multiple countries frame energy issues as a decisive political fight, linking national security, sovereignty and economic revival. In Norway, the Progress Party pushes for rapid nuclear licensing, while in the United States, Trump‑aligned media highlight a controversial diesel deal with Russia and attacks on offshore wind projects.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Calls for immediate nuclear power regulations and licensing as a way to secure Norway’s energy future.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Coverage of Trump’s Russian diesel purchase and efforts to rescind offshore wind permits, presented as protecting American energy independence.

signals: shared framing of energy as sovereignty
